name: VIBE
intro: VIBE是MiniMax推出的新基准，旨在衡量模型从零开始构建完整、可运行应用的全栈能力。它采用“Agent-as-a-Verifier” (AaaV) 范式，在真实的执行环境中自动评估应用的交互逻辑和视觉呈现，覆盖了Web、移动端（Android/iOS）、后端和科学模拟等多个领域。
org: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 200个人工整理应用规格, 容器化执行环境, 视觉Agent-as-a-Verifier
metric: 执行、交互和视觉/美学层
modality: 文本, 代码, 多模态
build_method_en: 200 curated application specifications, containerized execution environments, vision-enabled Agent-as-a-Verifier
intro_en: VIBE is a new benchmark introduced by MiniMax designed to measure a model's full-stack ability to build complete, functional applications from scratch. It uses the "Agent-as-a-Verifier" (AaaV) paradigm to automatically evaluate the interaction logic and visual presentation of applications in real execution environments, covering multiple domains including Web, mobile (Android/iOS), backend, and scientific simulation.
scale_en: 200 tasks across Web, simulation, Android, iOS, and backend

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Official MiniMax VIBE benchmark article and MiniMaxAI/VIBE dataset card; no standalone VIBE paper is cited by the release. MiniMax's VIBE (Visual & Interactive Benchmark for Execution) is a full-stack application benchmark, not the unrelated image-editing paper currently linked by this record. The official release curates 200 zero-to-one application specifications with difficulty and domain metadata across Web, scientific simulation, native Android, native iOS, and backend stacks. A coding agent builds each application in a containerized real execution environment. A vision-enabled Agent-as-a-Verifier acts as an autonomous QA tester, first checking compilation/build/launch, then completing user interactions and business workflows, and finally judging layout, hierarchy, color, and overall aesthetics. Scores remain separated into execution, interaction, and visual layers.
